items.text: Colts officially placed Alec Pierce on IR; elevated Nick Westbrook-Ikhine, signed Anthony Gould.
items.implication: Season multi-week absence; Downs perimeter role expands
items.opportunity: Josh Downs target share jumped to 36% post-Pierce exit; more outside routes

items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL (hip/groin); McVay indicates more unlikely than likely to play Week 3 at DEN, expected back Week 4 barring setback. No practice all week.
items.why: ETR Sunday injuries list + McVay comments via beat/Schefter/Rap
items.implication: High-end WR1 out; Adams carries primary load
items.opportunity: Routes/targets shift to Adams (42% target rate sans Nacua historically)

items.text: Nico Collins ruled OUT (hamstring) for Week 3 at IND; second straight miss (Grade 1 strain).
items.why: Official ruling confirmed by Schefter/Rapoport/ETR list
items.opportunity: Schultz team-high 28% target share last week sans Collins; routes open

items.text: Rico Dowdle OUT (toe) vs CIN; Jaylen Warren QUESTIONABLE (shoulder) but projected IN as lead back.
items.why: ETR list + Steelers RB coach: Warren will lead group, breathers for freshness
items.implication: Warren lead + checkdown volume vs Bengals
items.opportunity: Warren lead carries/routes; Homer/Heidenreich backups; vertical pass struggling so checkdowns

items.text: Jayden Daniels OUT (elbow) vs SEA; not IR, week-to-week aiming return ASAP. Positive longer-term. Mariota starts.
items.implication: QB downgrade short-term; McLaurin still viable but matchup tough
items.opportunity: Mariota target share historically solid for McLaurin (~25%)

items.text: JK Dobbins and RJ Harvey IN/ACTIVE (off IR/report) vs LAR; Jonah Coleman OUT (ankle).
items.why: ETR IN list + Schefter: off injury report good to go; Coleman ruled out
items.opportunity: Snap/carry share for healthy duo; reverse prior Coleman beneficiary

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs sets new ETR record ceiling projection 44.0 (avg top 25th %ile sim outcomes) for Week 3 main slate.
items.why: ETR sims/projections live; high usage opportunity

items.text: With Dowdle out, Jaylen Warren leads PIT RBs; expect zillion checkdowns as Rodgers vertical not working. Projecting Warren (shoulder Q) in. Backups Homer + Heidenreich.
items.why: Coach comment + usage data; LP practice but projected in

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected IR (core surgery, 6-8 weeks); Chuba Hubbard firmly lead role (RB14 utilization), AJ Dillon primary backup.
items.why: Coach timeline + utilization; ETR OUT list

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop 88.5; DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg. Feed him.
Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% target share both games; RB7 utilization (86); PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Loves Chris Olave vs LV (double-digit tgts, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows 18.7 ypr to WRs) and Dalton Schultz @ IND (28% tgt share sans Collins; IND 4th-most TE yds).
items.why: Target/air yards data + matchups; Collins out boosts Schultz

items.text: Hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX (31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble; JAX stout vs RBs), Travis Etienne vs LV (49% touches/38% 3rd-down snaps even w/ Kamara), Terry McLaurin vs SEA (fewest WR FPts allowed, low team total).
items.why: Snap/touch/role data + tough matchups; Daniels out for McLaurin but SEA elite vs WR
items.opportunity: Low for listed; Henderson narrowed gap vs Stevenson but still ranks Stevenson ahead
items.conflict: Henderson usage up but pass pro concerns
